decision: each view is its own vite build (build.mjs loops over folders with main.ts) giving one classic IIFE script and one stylesheet at dist/<view>/index.js|css
why: the host references fixed paths under a nonce; a multi-entry build would emit shared hashed module chunks

decision: CSP has no 'unsafe-inline' for styles
why: the kit needs none: Svelte compiles component styles into the bundle CSS and sets dynamic style: values through the CSSOM (style.cssText / setProperty), which CSP allows; no template carries a static style attribute

decision: the message list is a chat-local variable-height virtual list, not the kit VirtualList
why: kit VirtualList takes one fixed rowHeight; chat rows wrap, hold code blocks and images; rows are measured with ResizeObserver, estimated until then, bottom kept pinned and the reading position kept when rows above change
result: lane 5: 7 message rows in the DOM for 500 messages

decision: npm test stays dependency-free; build:webviews runs from vscode:prepublish and pretest:vscode, vitest is npm run test:webviews, svelte-check is npm run check:webviews
why: ci.yml runs npm test without npm install; a pretest build would break CI. I1 should add npm ci, build:webviews and test:webviews to CI
result: npm test exit 0 without a build
